_comment: Phase C / C/M0 semantic-recall gate corpus. HAND-AUTHORED. A pair = (stored turn = a PRIOR control-IN query, later = a NEW query about the SAME topic but LEXICALLY DIFFERENT so 6-5's exact-FNV-1a-over-the-query recall CANNOT match it -- only meaning-based query-to-query matching can). SYMMETRIC use case (both sides are queries), the faithful semantic extension of 6-5's key-over-the-query match. Split into two subsets after the C/M0 methodology finding: 'distinct' = topically DISTINCT stored turns (unambiguous ground truth -> the FAIR gate), 'adversarial' = a near-synonym cluster where several stored turns are siblings (a DISAMBIGUATION stress test, reported SEPARATELY -- exact-top-1 is legitimately hard there). HONEST: small + hand-authored -> a SIGNAL that gates C/M1, NOT a guarantee; the real validation is on-box with the accumulating control-IN store @21,140,000.
